about: The mail kit of ds: the design system's values written plainly, because a mail client reads no CSS variable (a mail's styles are inline, its layout tables). A mail is a white card ruled in gold on top, at most width wide, on the beige page; mail.html holds its parts. Selecta's mails and the site's take these values.

colorNotes.line: a gold line on white, the card's edge and a list's rules
colorNotes.gold: --gold-500, the card's top rule and the button
colorNotes.goldText: --gold-600, a label or a link in gold

fonts.title: Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif
fonts.fontNotes: Gilda Display and Urbanist, the site's fonts, are not in a mail client: Georgia and Helvetica take their place
